Database: PostgreSQL 17.
Hosting: Fly.io.
Rationale: PostgreSQL 17 + Fly.io is the standing standard for every new service.
turns.ask: We are starting a new inventory service. Which database and which hosting would you pick for it? Answer in three lines, no tickets yet.

turns.answer:
1. Data accuracy drift: stock counts can diverge from reality without regular reconciliation and audit trails.
2. Concurrency and race conditions: simultaneous updates (picks, receipts, transfers) can corrupt inventory state without proper locking/versioning.
3. Integration complexity: syncing with suppliers, POS, and shipping systems can introduce delays and inconsistent data.
turns.ask: List three risks of building it, one line each. No tickets.

turns.answer:
Dev A: data model, PostgreSQL schema, migrations, and core inventory API (items, stock levels, adjustments).
Dev B: integration layer (supplier/POS/shipping sync), audit/reconciliation jobs, and Fly.io deployment/ops.
